task: Mac mini Harness OS smartfarm operations dashboard

governance_bootstrap.summary: Completion requires requirement-to-evidence mapping, mobile-first UI, production entrypoint verification, and exact residual-risk reporting.
Origin main is source of truth; Mac mini deployment uses the selective deploy script; real API DB process and bundle evidence are required.

verification.name: focused smartfarm Python regression
verification.target: smartfarm runtime database Pi hub and pump safety
verification.result: 25 passed including concurrent DB access, command ack versus observation, fail-closed ON, guarded pump TEST, hub sequence/expiry, pump safety, MQTT packet sizing, diagnostic-failure alert promotion, and proof that a fresh heartbeat cannot hide an unresolved high-severity fault.

verification.name: frontend production bundle and scoped lint
verification.target: Harness OS smartfarm user interface production dist
verification.command: npm run build && npx eslint src/pages/SmartfarmPage.tsx src/components/TopBar.tsx
verification.result: Vite production build passed and the changed Smartfarm page/navigation lint passed with zero findings.

verification.name: telemetry date and time axis
verification.command: render five responsive axis ticks from recorded_at timestamps, then run Vite production build and scoped ESLint
verification.result: The trend line now uses actual recorded_at spacing and displays date plus 24-hour time for ranges of 6 hours or longer; short ranges display 24-hour time. Mobile keeps first, middle, and last labels to prevent overlap. Build and changed-file lint passed.

verification.name: top-level Harness OS smartfarm navigation
verification.target: desktop header and mobile quick navigation
verification.command: remove the Physical AI dropdown entry, add standalone smartfarm navigation, then run Vite production build and scoped ESLint
verification.result: Standalone 스마트팜 menu is present in the desktop top bar and mobile quick menu; production build and changed-file lint passed.

verification.name: guarded pump test workflow
verification.target: CEO-only dashboard API Pi hub edge observation and audit state machine
verification.command: focused Python tests plus Vite build and scoped lint for TEST control
verification.result: Pump TEST is separated from normal ON, limited to 1 to 3 seconds, requires an authenticated CEO session, an automatically issued one-use anti-replay token, and exact zone confirmation; it checks watchdog sensor and concurrency safety and reaches completed only after observed ON followed by automatic OFF.

verification.name: production pump test safety gate
verification.target: deployed Mac mini Harness OS bundle and authenticated production API
verification.command: deploy from origin/main, inspect production overview flags, reject TEST without a fresh nonce, reject a 4-second TEST, and confirm both observed pump states
verification.result: Production reports MQTT connected, normal actuation disabled, and pump TEST enabled. TEST uses a CEO-session-issued one-use token without password re-entry; a missing or replayed token returns 403 and a 4-second TEST returns 400.

verification.name: passwordless CEO-session pump authorization
verification.target: Harness OS CEO session token and pump replay boundary
verification.command: pytest session actuation plus smartfarm runtime hub and control suites; independent Gemini RED TEAM block, remediation, and clear
verification.result: 27 tests passed. Anonymous token issuance returned 401, VP issuance returned 403, CEO issuance returned 200, the first bounded TEST request passed in the mocked API contract, and replaying the same token returned 403. Gemini re-review returned red_team_clear.

verification.name: physical pump TEST cooldown and observation
verification.target: Mac mini command audit Raspberry Pi hub and Harness OS UI
verification.command: inspect production command ACKs, separate TEST anti-repeat from irrigation cooldown, preserve edge rejection reason, poll until observed ON then automatic OFF, and run focused regression plus Gemini RED TEAM
verification.result: Production diagnosis found pump TEST commands rejected as active_or_cooldown because fail-safe OFF started the 300-second irrigation cooldown. TEST now uses a separate 5-second anti-repeat window while normal irrigation keeps 300 seconds. Focused suite passed 29 tests and Gemini returned red_team_clear. Live command e77a81ac-57b5-439b-b8b0-846388d22ad2 received accepted on_dispatched ACK, MQTT observed OFF to ON to OFF in about 3.02 seconds, and the operational command reached completed with observed_state off.

verification.name: ESP32 and ESP8266 firmware compile
verification.command: arduino-cli compile for esp32:esp32:esp32 and esp8266:esp8266:nodemcuv2 using secret-free example configs
verification.result: Both board targets compiled; ESP32 used 69 percent flash and ESP8266 used 24 percent flash.

verification.name: ESP8266 live flash and packet-size fault detection
verification.target: production ESP8266 zone2 serial flash and MQTT
verification.command: Mac mini arduino-cli upload on /dev/cu.usbserial-0001 then MQTT heartbeat and telemetry observation
verification.result: Flash and hash verification passed and scalar telemetry resumed. Heartbeat initially failed because its JSON exceeded the PubSubClient 256-byte buffer; firmware was corrected to a 1024-byte buffer and both board compiles plus 22 focused tests passed before reflash.

verification.name: real Raspberry Pi MQTT and service inspection
verification.target: Raspberry Pi production broker database and telemetry
verification.command: mosquitto_sub -h 192.168.0.23 -t farm/# plus read-only SSH service check
verification.result: Mosquitto and harness-smartfarm-hub were active; zone2 emitted real soil_raw soil temp humidity and both zone pump states were OFF. Existing firmware had no heartbeat yet.

verification.name: local real FastAPI DB and safety entrypoint
verification.target: running Harness OS API and SQLite operational database
verification.command: uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8010 with seeded operational DB, authenticated overview history OFF and ON requests
verification.result: Overview returned 3 devices and 2 zones; history returned 30 points; disconnected OFF was truthfully blocked mqtt_not_connected; ON returned 409 actuation_disabled.

verification.name: Mac mini production dashboard data path
verification.target: Mac mini launchd backend production bundle MQTT and operational DB
verification.command: scripts/deploy_to_macmini.sh selected backend frontend launchd paths followed by authenticated production API and SQLite inspection
verification.result: Frontend atomic bundle index-D11nu3Sh.js contains Smartfarm Control Center; backend is running on 8000; MQTT and DB are connected; real zone1 and zone2 metrics are stored and history returns production points.

verification.name: Raspberry Pi hub and fail-safe OFF end to end
verification.target: production Pi hub broker edge node and command audit
verification.command: scripts/deploy_smartfarm_pi_hub.sh then production POST pump OFF and command polling
verification.result: Pi backup pre-dashboard-20260725_181010 was created, service restarted active, Pi heartbeat is online, and zone2 OFF transitioned published to ack to observed off with command 17b008ac-cd21-4ce7-807b-33a66af091ed.

verification.name: ESP8266 and ESP32 heartbeat and self-test
verification.target: physical zone2 ESP8266 and zone1 ESP32 through production dashboard API
verification.command: arduino-cli verified uploads followed by retained heartbeat and POST device self-test for both devices
verification.result: Both flashes passed hash verification. Both nodes report online identity boot ID watchdog and correct capabilities. ESP32 connectivity MQTT DHT passed with soil disabled and pump off. ESP8266 connectivity MQTT soil ADC passed with pump off; repeated DHT self-tests failed and the backend now promotes that result to device fault plus a high-severity alert.

verification.name: zone2 ESP8266 DHT and relay pin migration
verification.target: physical zone2 ESP8266 DHT22 on GPIO13 D7 and relay1 on GPIO14 D5
verification.command: fail-safe OFF, sync ignored zone2 config, arduino-cli compile and verified upload on /dev/cu.usbserial-0001, then production heartbeat and self-test
verification.result: Upload hash verified. Heartbeat reports online with 15000 ms watchdog. Self-test passed DHT22 at 30.1 C and 65 percent humidity, soil ADC raw 388, Wi-Fi and MQTT; pump remained OFF. The prior diagnostic alert resolved and zone2 returned online.

deploy.method: scripts/deploy_to_macmini.sh selected smartfarm backend frontend launchd and firmware source paths; scripts/deploy_smartfarm_pi_hub.sh for the Raspberry Pi owner
deploy.result: Mac mini backend and atomic frontend bundle index-CfPSz_UD.js deployed; Pi hub deployed with backup; ESP8266 and ESP32 firmware flashed and hash-verified; production API MQTT SQLite heartbeat diagnostic OFF observation and pump TEST safety rejection verified.

residual_risks: Physical ON remains intentionally disabled in production. Heartbeat and OFF are proven, but enabling water flow is a separate CEO safety decision.
In-app browser was unavailable, so visual desktop and mobile automation is not yet verified.
Full repository lint still has unrelated pre-existing findings; changed Smartfarm page and navigation lint are clean.
